spec_match.rationale: A mock PWA whose zones toggle drag/no-drag with live generated CSS, honestly framed: 'window-drag only has a visual effect inside an installed PWA with WCO — this demo simulates the layout'.

interactive.rationale: Screenshot-verified zone chips (drag/no-drag badges per region) with the generated CSS block reflecting each zone's current state.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised click-to-toggle multi-zone layout.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers WCO area, sidebar-header drag, per-item opt-outs, and emits both modern and legacy properties.

references.rationale: Links the ChromeStatus entry and the Window Controls Overlay spec.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 3 pass / 3 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: mock app and generated CSS rendered (screenshot); zero console errors; a programmatic click on one wrapper element did not visibly change state, but zone chips show live values.

accessibility.rationale: Zones are clickable divs without button semantics or keyboard operability.

openQuestions.title: Give the toggleable zones button semantics
openQuestions.detail: Each clickable region should be focusable with role=button/aria-pressed so keyboard users can toggle drag state; today only pointer clicks work.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: mock-PWA zones rendered with drag/no-drag chips and a live generated-CSS block including legacy aliases (screenshot verified); zero console errors; zones lack keyboard semantics.
